name: prompt-to-ship
description: From prompt to shipped change, in any language and on any git host. Each request becomes a brief and a plan reviewed by a fixed architect and product expert. The change is built with proof, reviewed in layers (fresh, security, validation) and delivered as a change request. It also debugs shipped code read-only, finds your next step, and starts a new project from an idea. A built-in design skill shapes new screens and checks every visible change. By default it never merges without your word.
